note: RT0020/RT0021 (tests/regression_training_cases.jsonl) are inherently a 2-turn sequence (a follow-up 'na vyrobu' depending on the prior 'kimchi na vyrobu' turn) - converted from two independent single-turn cases into one proper ConversationCase, since app.evaluation.runner deliberately isolates every GoldenCase into its own session and would otherwise never let turn 2 see turn 1's context.

turns.note: Must recommend kimchi-making ingredients (gochujang, fish sauce, rice flour, chili), not finished kimchi products.
Short follow-up must inherit the same ingredient context, not restart.
